lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement shows four to five distinct vertical columns of high-luminance blobs on the anterior visible flank, transitioning into a high-density, non-linear cluster of smaller blobs posterior to a vertical scar line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Wavy vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, forming a semi-regular grid pattern in the left half of the frame.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper margin of the flank, characterized by a light-to-shadow gradient transition running horizontally across the frame.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, vertical linear depression or scar is visible on the posterior third of the animal, creating a sharp physical indentation and a discontinuity in the skin patterning.
other_distinctive_markers: The skin pattern exhibits a distinct transition from large, sparsely distributed blobs to small, densely packed clusters across a vertical boundary marked by physical trauma.
